newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.150 to up 0.100 cent. Carryover selling likely on weak beef but may be overdone.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Index up and corn futures seen off, should offset spillover from live cattle.
HOGS - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Carryover liquidation likely but higher product and steady live supportive.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.500 cent. Out-of-town called bearish but cash strong and hog kills down.
